snippet.title: Reef Defense Gameplay on Steam
snippet.description:
Reef Defense is a fast-paced, intense strategy game where relentless waves of crustaceans are coming for your precious eggs! Arm your reef with strategically positioned defenses and hold the line. Can you outlast the swarm, or will your eggs become crab food?

Reef Defense released June 20th, 2025 on Steam.   

You may find it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/343160/Reef_Defense
